title: Complete coherence of one operation pair
statement: Fix a prime l and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l. Index coefficients by the finite intermediate fields E of Ω/Q_l, as in [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Let q : U → V be a morphism of noetherian schemes of finite topological Krull dimension, with l invertible on both schemes. Use the actual completed operations of [lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange], the ambient completed integral, raw rational and Karoubi coefficient systems of [def-sbc-ambient-complete-coefficient-categories], and the predicates of [def-sbc-finite-stage-rational-exchange-data]. There exist pPush,pPull,rPush,rPull satisfying HasOperationCoherence, including all clauses of HasRawOperationCoherence and the additive Karoubi system morphisms extending both raw morphisms. The Karoubi Φ are functorExtension₂.obj of the raw Φ, the Karoubi β are heterogeneously equal to functorExtension₂.mapIso of the raw β, and the reflexive β are identities.

proof.text: Obtain the integral and raw data from rationalRawOperationCoherence. Retain all eighteen raw clauses verbatim. Apply completeKarMorphism to rPush and rPull. Its object and beta formulas and additive extension give the Karoubi clauses; completeKarMorphism_unit gives the normalized units.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalOperationCoherence :
  ∃ (pPush : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) q ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω V a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω U a ⋙
        sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) q),
  ∃ (pPull : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) q ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω U a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω V a ⋙
        sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) q),
  ∃ (rPush : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω U)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω V)),
  ∃ (rPull : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω V)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω U)),
    HasOperationCoherence l Ω q pPush pPull rPush rPull
